CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2609 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 97ac438d6be48b92b27dc4d47ba258dbbd84710d. Bus nonce: efe053c14afcd160a8e8f59cb7737e3a. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 97ac438d6be48b92b27dc4d47ba258dbbd84710d`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 97ac438d6be48b92b27dc4d47ba258dbbd84710d` or `Fix review: blocked 97ac438d6be48b92b27dc4d47ba258dbbd84710d <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: efe053c14afcd160a8e8f59cb7737e3a`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `97ac438d6be48b92b27dc4d47ba258dbbd84710d` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2609 97ac438d6be48b92b27dc4d47ba258dbbd84710d") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2609-efe053c1`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Delta review of PR #2609 (group R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST, branch fix/r10-arch-docs-first) at head 97ac438d6be48b92b27dc4d47ba258dbbd84710d. Its round-3 review returned `Fix review: merge c00082a9ae41447820af2a73c8fe4d1a2d661c8c` (git fetch origin review/2609; VERDICT.md). Since then: (a) the merge train re-carried main 47147487b (#2607) into ff83a3d7; (b) the train stopped on a real red, fast (3.14) check-run 119826108493: tests/harness_headers.py found dev/audit/rounds/round4/D6/claims.json and claims.md stale; (c) the orchestrator added commit 97ac438d6, re-recording those two files, and updated the body's ## Head and ## Red checks. The orchestrator authored that commit, so you are its independent reviewer. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md; this is a resolution-delta review, not a re-review of the docs. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required:
1. `git log --no-merges c00082a9ae41447820af2a73c8fe4d1a2d661c8c..97ac438d6be48b92b27dc4d47ba258dbbd84710d ^origin/main` lists only 97ac438d6. Its diff touches only the two D6 claims files, and only rows C108 and C110 move.
2. The re-record is honest. At the head, run `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub:custom_components:tests python3 dev/audit/rounds/round4/D6/claims.py` and confirm it leaves the tree byte-identical. Then independently count README.md + docs/*.md relative links and embedded images at origin/main and at the head, and confirm the 81->84 and 21->22 deltas come from this PR's own README and docs changes (the coffee button, the dev/README.md pointer and so on), not from main drift. Name the 3 links and the 1 image.
3. `python3 tests/harness_headers.py` at the head prints ALL ... PASSED.
4. Body: ## Red checks names the fast (3.14) red with cause, cheaper detector and Carry; ## Head names 97ac438d6be48b92b27dc4d47ba258dbbd84710d. carry_audit.py check --body against origin/main's roster gives 0 unrouted and 0 bad. Read pr-contract and fast (3.14) at this head from check-runs. If they are still running, report that; it is not a block.
5. git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 97ac438d6be48b92b27dc4d47ba258dbbd84710d must be clean. ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head. No /Users/ or /private/ path may appear in VERDICT.md or ev/.
Time box 25 min.
